title: Useful orientation and efficient context restoration
summary: Explain where to resume and deliver complete required context without avoidable repetition.
description:
Explain where to resume and deliver complete required context without avoidable repetition.

Current state: extend existing Agent Plan functionality; see each task for the verified starting point. This phase follows B and owns only the outcomes below.

Outcomes:
- Make multiple handoffs understandable after a long absence.
- Restore necessary context across sessions, compaction, task switches and source changes.

Tasks and boundaries:
- C1: Replace handoff choice lists with an actionable resume overview. A bounded overview of purpose, current/partial state, remaining work, blockers, return obligations and a recommendation justified by the shared selector.
- C2: Coordinate complete context delivery and freshness-aware reuse. A coordinated context protocol that restores mandatory rules, requirements and decisions, reuses genuinely available unchanged content, and reports incomplete delivery.

Preserve canonical planner identity, phase-scoped handoffs, derived status and session ownership. Read existing code precedents before implementation; use the current task checklist for steps. Source locations are navigation evidence at c4d0c459f74f5365c9ab8a9fe53ad6d7907a8231, not permanent anchors.

tasks.title: Coordinate complete context delivery and freshness-aware reuse
tasks.description:
Outcome: A coordinated context protocol that restores mandatory rules, requirements and decisions, reuses genuinely available unchanged content, and reports incomplete delivery.

Existing state: Project context delivery, full-read attestations and phase/task context already exist, with overlapping payloads and contradictory instructions across surfaces.

Implementation responsibility:
- Measure actual bytes/characters and tokens separately on equivalent resume scenarios.
- Reconcile skill, core rules, tool descriptions and injected prompts around one read-before-work protocol.
- Refresh context after supported compaction/reset events; provide an explicit restoration path for harnesses without those events.
- Invalidate only affected reads when source revisions change and distinguish delivery from understanding.
- Preserve bounded transport, explicit continuation and typed incomplete/non-success results.

Acceptance and evidence:
- No required rule, requirement or decision is silently omitted to meet a budget.
- Persistent attestations alone never prove retained model context.
- Equivalent scenarios demonstrate avoided duplication without an unverified performance promise.

Detailed discussion contract:
- A persisted session ID/read timestamp can survive loss of model context; add explicit restoration and supported lifecycle/compaction refresh rather than relying on that timestamp.
- Reuse only content that is unchanged AND still available in effective model context. Do not drop required rules/requirements/decisions to meet a budget.
- Report partial/truncated/continued delivery and measure characters/bytes/tokens honestly on comparable flows; no percentage saving is established.

Read .planner/docs/agent-brain-registration-handoff.md for full mechanisms, examples and coverage mapping. Exact proposed fields/tool versions/storage engines remain choices in the owning task, not already implemented or automatically approved facts.

Shared-planner expansion approved 21 October 2026:
Context reuse keys include explicit workspace/source and execution/target revision, as well as planner versions. Read/context receipts are caller-scoped even when canonical knowledge is shared. Workspace switch, source drift, integration/revert and authority rebinding invalidate affected evidence; a stored receipt never proves retained model content.

Full binding, execution/integration, migration and recovery contracts: .planner/docs/agent-brain-shared-planner-and-execution.md. The older mergeable plan layout described in current source documentation is the baseline being evolved, not the new storage policy. This registration does not implement or migrate it.

Hierarchy/dependency consistency and token-cost contract (21 October 2026):
Use M3 impact receipts and effective-context hashes to deliver relevant deltas. Avoid unconditional full task/phase/feature/project reload after each mutation; restore actual missing mandatory context after compaction and paginate genuinely large impact. Validate A2 flow budgets for resume, repeated mutations, graph/context and source/editor events.
Full contract: .planner/docs/agent-brain-impact-reconciliation-and-token-budgets.md. Requirements BR28/BR29 apply across the feature; no implementation is started by registration.
